methods.label: Check the equal-likelihood requirement
methods.explanation: The value 1/6 is calculated using \(P=m/n\), which requires all outcomes to be equally likely. When the die is biased, the scores are not equally likely, so 1/6 cannot be used directly.
methods.levelReason: Checks the elementary condition for using favorable outcomes divided by total outcomes.

review.mathematicalCheck: Bias means equal probabilities for all six scores are unavailable, so counting one favorable face out of six does not justify 1/6. The wording 'cannot be used directly' correctly limits the conclusion: a biased die could still happen to have \(P(6)=1/6\). Choice B is justified in this qualified sense.
